events.text: CORRECTION to req_2816 analysis: the JS studio DOES have the guard — the Concave-face Auto-Fix (req_0949): isFaceConcave/newConcaveFaces in cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/editMesh.ts:952, fired from studiokit/StudioViewport.tsx:2371 on gizmo release, dialog ConcaveFixPopup.tsx ('N faces buckled — not convex', Split Quads/Ignore/Revert). The real divergence: the native port kept the DIALOG but replaced the PREDICATE. JS tests an exact state property — does the authored polygon loop have a reflex corner (turn-sign test against the Newell normal), diffed per-face so only NEWLY concave faces fire; convexity is rigid-motion invariant so rotations mathematically cannot false-positive, and collinear corners are skipped so slivers cannot either. Zig (collectUnsafeFaceEdits, 3d.zig:2734) instead measures a per-TRIANGLE differential heuristic between snapshots (area ratio 1e-6, normal dot -0.05, rigid exemption 2e-3) — no concavity test exists anywhere in it. req_2754/2755 patched the invented predicate's cliffs; the sliver-conditioning failure mode remains. Fix: port isFaceConcave/newConcaveFaces semantics to authored groups in Zig (boundary loops already derivable — mesh_edit.zig edgeIsBoundaryPub), and make Split Quads pick the convex diagonal like JS splitQuad instead of keeping the frozen one.
